sources.snippet: FaceCertify is an AI-powered facial recognition system designed to automate student verification and attendance during academic examinations. It provides a seamless, real-time identity check for students entering the exam hall, thereby enhancing academic integrity, eliminating impersonation, and saving administrative effort.
